answer_1.quote: In this paper, we focus on a simple yet effective method that improves named entity translation within context... We conduct our experiments on three language pairs: English‑Russian, English‑Ukrainian and English‑Nepali translations...

answer_2.quote: We report the results in sacreBLEU... we compare all methods in terms of BLEU and chrF on the test data... we further perform a fine‑grained evaluation by the entity translation accuracy...
